limitations: Original PASS/FAIL and insufficient diagnostics gates are unchanged.
Fully interior snapshots only; fewer than two snapshots makes proc unavailable, never zero.
Actual window min(planned end, stop, scheduler); original native whole SHA is referenced, not recomputed.
Exact four worker identities bound to observer start and all selected samples; runtime has no frozen worker set.
OFF optional diagnostic flags and absent JFR are checked; publisher diagnostics and three event lanes remain enabled.
No JFR: allocation and GC pauses unavailable. FD table size is not open FD peak.
Endpoint queue occupancy cannot establish instantaneous fullness or identify an individual timeout.
CPU100%=one logical CPU; topology and Windows interference limit hardware ceiling claims.
WMI formatted counters may be cached. Sample arithmetic means are not full-window averages; read latency is wall time, observer cost unquantified.
